pairs.target: tīng cái shì lǐ méiyǒu yǐbèi , zhǐyǒu yìpáipái néng kuàzuò de chángdèng .
pairs.english: The material-listening room had no chair backs, only rows of benches you could straddle.
pairs.hanzi: 听材室里没有椅背，只有一排排能跨坐的长凳。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dào shí , mǐlā zhèng bǎ mùhé sāijìn zhuōxià .
pairs.english: When Tavi arrived, Mira was pushing her wooden box under the table.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维到时，米拉正把木盒塞进桌下。

pairs.target: tā kànjiàn tā , tái shǒuzhǐ le zhǐ shēnpáng de kōng chù .
pairs.english: Seeing him, she raised a hand and pointed to the empty space beside her.
pairs.hanzi: 她看见他，抬手指了指身旁的空处。

pairs.target: tā zuòxià cái fāxiàn , nàlǐ zhèngduìzhe chuāng , fēng bǎ zhuōshàng de zhǐ chuī dé yìjiǎo yijiǎo fān .
pairs.english: Only when he sat did he notice it faced the window, where wind kept lifting the paper's corners on the table.
pairs.hanzi: 他坐下才发现，那里正对着窗，风把桌上的纸吹得一角一角翻。

pairs.target: " nǐ zuótiān yě zhème ràngzuò ? " tā wèn .
pairs.english: “Is this how you offered a seat yesterday too?” he asked.
pairs.hanzi: “你昨天也这么让座？”他问。

pairs.target: " zuótiān méi fēng . "
pairs.english: “There was no wind yesterday.”
pairs.hanzi: “昨天没风。”

pairs.target: tā jiāng mùhé ná chūlái yā zhǐ , zìjǐ yě wǎng zhōngjiān nuó le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: She brought out the box to hold the paper down and shifted a little toward the middle herself.
pairs.hanzi: 她将木盒拿出来压纸，自己也往中间挪了一点。

pairs.target: qiánmiàn de zhuōshàng jià zhe liǎngpiàn zhǎi gāngtiáo , mòduān xuánkōng , gēnbù jiá zài mù zuò lǐ .
pairs.english: Two narrow steel strips stood on the front table, tips suspended and bases clamped into wooden mounts.
pairs.hanzi: 前面的桌上架着两片窄钢条，末端悬空，根部夹在木座里。

pairs.target: yǒurén cāi yào shì dāokǒu , yǒurén shuō shì chēng dōngxī de .
pairs.english: Some guessed they would test cutting edges; others said it was for weighing things.
pairs.hanzi: 有人猜要试刀口，有人说是称东西的。

pairs.target: yìmíng chuān shēnhuī duǎnyī de nǚrén zǒujìn lái , xiùzǐ yìbiān gāo , yìbiān dī ,
pairs.english: A woman in a dark-gray short jacket entered, one sleeve rolled higher than the other,
pairs.hanzi: 一名穿深灰短衣的女人走进来，袖子一边高，一边低，

pairs.target: huáilǐ bào zhe gè zhuāngmǎn xiǎo mùchuí de kuāng .
pairs.english: carrying a basket full of small wooden mallets.
pairs.hanzi: 怀里抱着个装满小木槌的筐。

pairs.target: tā bǎ kuāng fàngxià , ná qǐ yìzhī mùchuí , qiāo le qiāo liǎngpiàn gāngtiáo .
pairs.english: She set it down, picked up a mallet and tapped both steel strips.
pairs.hanzi: 她把筐放下，拿起一只木槌，敲了敲两片钢条。

pairs.target: liǎngshēng qīng xiǎng , yìgāoyìdī .
pairs.english: Two clear notes, one high, one low.
pairs.hanzi: 两声清响，一高一低。

pairs.target: " wéi lǎoshī . " qiánpái yǒurén xiǎoshēng tíxǐng shēnbiān de rén .
pairs.english: “Instructor Vey,” someone in front whispered to their neighbor.
pairs.hanzi: “维老师。”前排有人小声提醒身边的人。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi biàn bǎ zhège míngzì jìzhù .
pairs.english: Tavi remembered the name.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维便把这个名字记住。

pairs.target: tā yòu qiāo yícì , wèn yǒuméiyǒu rén juéde liǎngshēng yíyàng .
pairs.english: She tapped again and asked whether anyone thought the two notes were the same.
pairs.hanzi: 她又敲一次，问有没有人觉得两声一样。

pairs.target: méi rén jǔshǒu .
pairs.english: Nobody raised a hand.
pairs.hanzi: 没人举手。

pairs.target: " zuìhòu yìpái , nǐmen tīngjiàn le méiyǒu ? "
pairs.english: “Back row, did you hear?”
pairs.hanzi: “最后一排，你们听见了没有？”

pairs.target: yǒurén shuō zhī tīngjiàn pángbiān de rén késou .
pairs.english: Someone said all they heard was the person beside them coughing.
pairs.hanzi: 有人说只听见旁边的人咳嗽。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zhuōzi wǎngqián tuō le yìdiǎn , mù jiǎo zài dìshàng jiānjiào , mǎnwū rén dōu suō le suōbózi .
pairs.english: She dragged the table forward a little; its wooden feet shrieked on the floor, making the whole room flinch.
pairs.hanzi: 她把桌子往前拖了一点，木脚在地上尖叫，满屋人都缩了缩脖子。

pairs.target: " zhège dǎo dōu tīngjiàn le . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “Everyone heard that one,” she said.
pairs.hanzi: “这个倒都听见了。”她说。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào zhe táitóu , jiàn tā fàngxià mùchuí ,
pairs.english: Tavi looked up laughing and saw her put down the mallet,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑着抬头，见她放下木槌，

pairs.target: liǎngshǒu gè tiēzhù yípiàn gāngtiáo kàojìn jiá zuò de dìfāng .
pairs.english: resting each hand on a steel strip near its clamp.
pairs.hanzi: 两手各贴住一片钢条靠近夹座的地方。

pairs.target: tā ràng qiánpái xuéshēng ná chuí , zhào gāngcái de wèizhì qīngqiāo zìyóu de yìduān .
pairs.english: She had a front-row student take the mallet and tap the free end gently at the same spot as before.
pairs.hanzi: 她让前排学生拿槌，照刚才的位置轻敲自由的一端。

pairs.target: gāo de nà shēng dīxiàqù le . lìng yìshēng què wǎngshàngpá .
pairs.english: The high note dropped. The other climbed.
pairs.hanzi: 高的那声低下去了。另一声却往上爬。

pairs.target: liǎngzhǒng shēngyīn pèng zài yìqǐ , xiàng běnlái gé zhe yìtiáo gōu de rén hūrán zhàn dào tóng yíshànmén lǐ .
pairs.english: The two sounds met, like people once separated by a ditch suddenly standing in the same doorway.
pairs.hanzi: 两种声音碰在一起，像本来隔着一条沟的人忽然站到同一扇门里。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rènde shǒudǐxià nàzhǒng sōng yǔ jǐn , què méi xiǎng guò ěrduo yě néng tīngjiàn .
pairs.english: Tavi knew that yielding and resistance beneath his hands, but had never imagined hearing it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维认得手底下那种松与紧，却没想过耳朵也能听见。

pairs.target: tā rěnbúzhù xiàngqián qīng , mǐlā shēnshǒu dǎngzhù tā de gēbo , miǎnde dǎfān mò dié .
pairs.english: He leaned forward involuntarily; Mira caught his arm to keep him from upsetting the ink dish.
pairs.hanzi: 他忍不住向前倾，米拉伸手挡住他的胳膊，免得打翻墨碟。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī shōu shǒu , děng le yíhuìer , zài jiào nà xuéshēng qiāo .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey withdrew her hands, waited a moment, then had the student tap again.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师收手，等了一会儿，再叫那学生敲。

pairs.target: shēngyīn fēnkāi le .
pairs.english: The notes separated.
pairs.hanzi: 声音分开了。

pairs.target: " jiè xìng huì gǎi tā tándòng de kuàimàn .
pairs.english: “Property borrowing changes how fast it vibrates.
pairs.hanzi: “借性会改它弹动的快慢。

pairs.target: nǐmen yǐqián kàn de kěnéng shì wān duōshǎo , jīntiān tīng . "
pairs.english: You may have watched how far it bends before. Today, listen.”
pairs.hanzi: 你们以前看的可能是弯多少，今天听。”

pairs.target: yígènánhái wèn , néng bunéng bǎ zìjǐ de shēngyīn jiègěi biérén .
pairs.english: A boy asked whether he could lend his voice to someone else.
pairs.hanzi: 一个男孩问，能不能把自己的声音借给别人。

pairs.target: hòupái lìkè yǒurén xué tā shuōhuà , wěiyīn tuō dé lǎo cháng .
pairs.english: Someone in the back immediately mimicked him, stretching out the last syllable.
pairs.hanzi: 后排立刻有人学他说话，尾音拖得老长。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī cháo nàbiān kàn le yìyǎn .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey glanced that way.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师朝那边看了一眼。

pairs.target: " nǐ pángbiān nàge yǐjīng huì le . "
pairs.english: “The person next to you already can.”
pairs.hanzi: “你旁边那个已经会了。”

pairs.target: xiàoshēng yìqǐ , tā yě xiào ,
pairs.english: Laughter rose, and she laughed too,
pairs.hanzi: 笑声一起，她也笑，

pairs.target: děng xiàoshēng guòqù cái shuō : " zhè liǎngpiàn gāng de biànhuà , gēn sǎngzi búshì yì huíshì .
pairs.english: then waited for it to pass before saying, “What happens in these two steel strips isn't the same as a voice.
pairs.hanzi: 等笑声过去才说：“这两片钢的变化，跟嗓子不是一回事。

pairs.target: bié kànjiàn shénme dōu wǎng yígè míngzì lǐ zhuāng . "
pairs.english: Don't put everything you see under one name.”
pairs.hanzi: 别看见什么都往一个名字里装。”

pairs.target: mùchuí chuándào hòumiàn .
pairs.english: The mallets were passed to the back.
pairs.hanzi: 木槌传到后面。

pairs.target: měizhāng zhuōshàng dōu yǒu liǎngpiàn zhuāng hǎo de gāngtiáo , chángdù , hòubáo bù quán xiāngtóng .
pairs.english: Each table had two mounted steel strips, not all of the same length and thickness.
pairs.hanzi: 每张桌上都有两片装好的钢条，长度、厚薄不全相同。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi nà zhuō háiyǒu yípiàn jiào duǎn de , dān fàngzài ruǎnbù shàng , méiyǒu jiá hǎo .
pairs.english: Tavi's table also had a shorter piece lying separately on soft cloth, not clamped.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维那桌还有一片较短的，单放在软布上，没有夹好。

pairs.target: mǐlā ná chǐ qù liáng , tā xiān pèng le pèng gāngtiáo de cèbiān .
pairs.english: Mira took her ruler to measure; he first touched the side of a strip.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉拿尺去量，他先碰了碰钢条的侧边。

pairs.target: " zhè piàn báo yìdiǎn . "
pairs.english: “This one's a little thinner.”
pairs.hanzi: “这片薄一点。”

pairs.target: " wǒ zhīdào . xiān liáng lùchū lái duōcháng . "
pairs.english: “I know. First measure how much sticks out.”
pairs.hanzi: “我知道。先量露出来多长。”

pairs.target: tā jiāng chǐ tuīguòlái , tǎ wéi kànjiàn mìmìde xì gé , shǒu tíng le yíxià .
pairs.english: She pushed the ruler over; Tavi saw the closely spaced little divisions and his hand paused.
pairs.hanzi: 她将尺推过来，塔维看见密密的细格，手停了一下。

pairs.target: mǐlā yǐjīng zài zhǐ shàng xiě le yígè shù , shēnshǒu lái liáng lìngyìbiān .
pairs.english: Mira had already written a number and reached to measure the other side.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉已经在纸上写了一个数，伸手来量另一边。

pairs.target: " nǐ zěnme zhīdào wǒ shuō nǎ piàn ? "
pairs.english: “How do you know which one I mean?”
pairs.hanzi: “你怎么知道我说哪片？”

pairs.target: " yǎnjīng kàn dédào . "
pairs.english: “I can see it.”
pairs.hanzi: “眼睛看得到。”

pairs.target: tā bǎshǒu shōuhuí lái , yǒuxiē bú tòngkuài .
pairs.english: He drew his hand back, feeling annoyed.
pairs.hanzi: 他把手收回来，有些不痛快。

pairs.target: gāngcái shēnguòqù de nà yíxià , hūrán xiàng duōyú .
pairs.english: His gesture suddenly seemed unnecessary.
pairs.hanzi: 刚才伸过去的那一下，忽然像多余。

pairs.target: liǎng rén fēnbié qiāo le qiāo , guǒrán cháng de nà piàn shēngyīn dī .
pairs.english: They each tapped, and the longer strip did sound lower.
pairs.hanzi: 两人分别敲了敲，果然长的那片声音低。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō jiāng cháng de wǎng jiá zuò lǐ shōu yìdiǎn , yě néng biàn gāo , bù yídìng yào jiè xìng .
pairs.english: Mira said sliding the longer one farther into its clamp could also raise the note, without necessarily borrowing properties.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说将长的往夹座里收一点，也能变高，不一定要借性。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bú xìn , tā què méi dòng jiá zuò , zhī jiāng zhège cāifǎ xiě zài zhǐbiān , děng lǎoshī guòlái .
pairs.english: Tavi did not believe her, but she left the clamp alone and wrote the guess in the margin, waiting for the teacher.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维不信，她却没动夹座，只将这个猜法写在纸边，等老师过来。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī kàn le , diǎntóu , shuō xià yìlún kěyǐ huàn chángdù , yǎnxià xiānzhào yuányàng zuò .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey read it, nodded and said they could change the length next round; for now, use the original setup.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师看了，点头，说下一轮可以换长度，眼下先照原样做。

pairs.target: mǐlā cháo tǎ wéi yáng le yángméi . tā dītóu jiǎnqǐ mùchuí , jiǎzhuāng méi kànjiàn .
pairs.english: Mira raised her eyebrows at Tavi. He bent to pick up the mallet, pretending not to notice.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉朝塔维扬了扬眉。他低头捡起木槌，假装没看见。

pairs.target: lún dào tāmen shì shí , wéi lǎoshī zhàn zài zhuōbiān , xiān tiáo hǎo liǎngpiàn de wèizhì ,
pairs.english: When their turn came, Instructor Vey stood beside the table and adjusted the two strips' positions,
pairs.hanzi: 轮到他们试时，维老师站在桌边，先调好两片的位置，

pairs.target: ràng tǎ wéi jiāng zhǐ fù dāshàngqù .
pairs.english: then had Tavi rest his fingertips on them.
pairs.hanzi: 让塔维将指腹搭上去。

pairs.target: mǐlā qiāo , qiāo dé tài xiǎng , gāngtiáo mòduān huàng chéng yíxiàn guāng .
pairs.english: Mira struck too loudly; the strip's tip shimmered into a line of light.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉敲，敲得太响，钢条末端晃成一线光。

pairs.target: lǎoshī yòngshǒuzhǎng cháo xiàyā le yā , tā dìèrhuí biàn qīng duō le .
pairs.english: The teacher lowered her palm, and Mira's second tap was much lighter.
pairs.hanzi: 老师用手掌朝下压了压，她第二回便轻多了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiān tīngjiàn chuāng biān de niǎo , suíhòu shì gébì zhuō de yì shēngxiǎng .
pairs.english: Tavi first heard a bird by the window, then a note from the next table.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维先听见窗边的鸟，随后是隔壁桌的一声响。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng fēnqīng zìjǐ shǒuxià de shēngyīn , fǎnér juéde mǎnwū dōu shì tóngyígè yīn .
pairs.english: Trying to distinguish the sound beneath his hands, he instead felt the whole room was one note.
pairs.hanzi: 他想分清自己手下的声音，反而觉得满屋都是同一个音。

pairs.target: " děng tāmen nà zhuō tíng . " mǐlā xiǎoshēng shuō .
pairs.english: “Wait until that table stops,” Mira whispered.
pairs.hanzi: “等他们那桌停。”米拉小声说。

pairs.target: tā děng le jǐ xī , chóngxīn tiē wěn shǒu .
pairs.english: He waited a few breaths, then settled his hands again.
pairs.hanzi: 他等了几息，重新贴稳手。

pairs.target: shúxī de chābié mànmàn chūxiàn , zuǒbiān xiàng wǎng lǐ ràng le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: The familiar difference slowly emerged, the left side seeming to yield a little.
pairs.hanzi: 熟悉的差别慢慢出现，左边像往里让了一点。

pairs.target: mǐlā qīngqiāo liǎngxià , zhèhuí liǎngshēng zhījiān de jùlí quèshí zhǎi le .
pairs.english: Mira tapped lightly twice; this time the gap between the notes really narrowed.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉轻敲两下，这回两声之间的距离确实窄了。

pairs.target: tā sōngshǒu , niē le niē zhǐjiān , méiyǒu má .
pairs.english: He let go and pinched his fingertips. No numbness.
pairs.hanzi: 他松手，捏了捏指尖，没有麻。

pairs.target: " tīng chūlái le ? " tā wèn .
pairs.english: “Did you hear it?” he asked.
pairs.hanzi: “听出来了？”他问。

pairs.target: mǐlā zhòu zhe bízi .
pairs.english: Mira wrinkled her nose.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉皱着鼻子。

pairs.target: " dìyīshēng yǒu . dìèrshēng wǒ méi tīng qīng . "
pairs.english: “The first one, yes. I didn't hear the second clearly.”
pairs.hanzi: “第一声有。第二声我没听清。”

pairs.target: tā běnlái xiǎng shuō liǎngbiān dōu biàn le ,
pairs.english: He wanted to say both had changed,
pairs.hanzi: 他本来想说两边都变了，

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī què zhèngzài zhǐ shàngbiāo wèizhì , jiào xià yìzhuō zhǔnbèi , méiyǒu tì tāmen zhēng .
pairs.english: but Instructor Vey was marking positions on the paper and telling the next table to prepare, not settling their argument.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师却正在纸上标位置，叫下一桌准备，没有替他们争。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhǐhǎo zìjǐ zài huíxiǎng .
pairs.english: Tavi had to think back for himself.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维只好自己再回想。

pairs.target: lí tā zuìjìn de nàge yīn qīngchǔ , lìng yígè hùn zài niǎojiào lǐ , yuè xiǎng yuè bùgǎn shuō .
pairs.english: The nearer note was clear; the other mingled with birdsong, and the more he thought, the less sure he was.
pairs.hanzi: 离他最近的那个音清楚，另一个混在鸟叫里，越想越不敢说。

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ mùchuí fàngdào ruǎnbù shàng , méiyǒu mǎshàng jì jiéguǒ .
pairs.english: Mira laid the mallet on the soft cloth without immediately recording the result.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把木槌放到软布上，没有马上记结果。

pairs.target: " wǒ gāngcái shìbushì yòu qiāo zhòng le ? "
pairs.english: “Did I hit too hard again?”
pairs.hanzi: “我刚才是不是又敲重了？”

pairs.target: " yǒu yìdiǎn . "
pairs.english: “A little.”
pairs.hanzi: “有一点。”

pairs.target: " nà xiān xiě wǒ qiāo zhòng le . "
pairs.english: “Then write that I hit too hard first.”
pairs.hanzi: “那先写我敲重了。”

pairs.target: tā shuō dé bùzěnme gāoxìng .
pairs.english: She did not sound particularly happy.
pairs.hanzi: 她说得不怎么高兴。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi fǎndǎo sōng le xiē , ná qǐbǐ , zài zhǐ shàng huà le liǎngtiáoxiàn ,
pairs.english: Tavi relaxed a little instead and picked up the pen to draw two lines on the paper,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维反倒松了些，拿起笔，在纸上画了两条线，

pairs.target: yìtiáo kàojìn , lìng yìtiáo zhōngjiàn duànkāi .
pairs.english: one closer in, the other broken in the middle.
pairs.hanzi: 一条靠近，另一条中间断开。

pairs.target: mǐlā kàn le yíhuìer , wèn duàn de shì tīngbùqīng , háishì méi biàn .
pairs.english: Mira studied it a moment and asked whether the break meant unclear hearing or no change.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉看了一会儿，问断的是听不清，还是没变。

pairs.target: tā zài pángbiān tiān le yígè xiǎoěrduo , huà dé xiàng zhī dòujiá .
pairs.english: He added a little ear beside it, drawn like a bean pod.
pairs.hanzi: 他在旁边添了一个小耳朵，画得像只豆荚。

pairs.target: tā xiào dé jiāng bǐjiān chuō chū yígè mòdiǎn .
pairs.english: She laughed so hard her pen jabbed an ink blot onto the page.
pairs.hanzi: 她笑得将笔尖戳出一个墨点。

pairs.target: xiàkè qián , wéi lǎoshī sōngkāi shìfàn zhuōshàng de jiá zuò , nuó duǎn qízhōng yípiàn , zài qiāo .
pairs.english: Before class ended, Instructor Vey loosened the demonstration clamp, shortened one exposed strip, and tapped again.
pairs.hanzi: 下课前，维老师松开示范桌上的夹座，挪短其中一片，再敲。

pairs.target: shēngyīn guǒrán gāo le .
pairs.english: The note did rise.
pairs.hanzi: 声音果然高了。

pairs.target: mǐlā lìkè zhuǎntóu . tǎ wéi zhècì méi duǒ .
pairs.english: Mira turned immediately. This time Tavi did not look away.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉立刻转头。塔维这次没躲。

pairs.target: " xíng , nǐ shuō duì le . "
pairs.english: “Fine. You were right.”
pairs.hanzi: “行，你说对了。”

pairs.target: tā jiāng chǐ shōu jìn hé cáo , zuǐjiǎo yā le yā , méiyǒu yāzhù .
pairs.english: She put her ruler in its groove and tried unsuccessfully to suppress a smile.
pairs.hanzi: 她将尺收进盒槽，嘴角压了压，没有压住。

pairs.target: rén zǒu dé chàbùduō shí , chuāng biān de niǎo yòu jiào qǐlái .
pairs.english: When most people had left, the bird by the window began calling again.
pairs.hanzi: 人走得差不多时，窗边的鸟又叫起来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ zhǐjiá jìn kè dān , kànjiàn bèimiàn nà sāngè càimíng yòngzì ,
pairs.english: Tavi tucked the paper into his class sheet and saw the three characters for the vegetable on the back,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把纸夹进课单，看见背面那三个菜名用字，

pairs.target: pángbiān xīntiān le yìzhī bú xiàng ěrduo de ěrduo .
pairs.english: now beside a newly added ear that did not look like an ear.
pairs.hanzi: 旁边新添了一只不像耳朵的耳朵。

pairs.target: mǐlā yǐjīng dào ménbiān , wèn tā qùbuqù chīfàn .
pairs.english: Mira was already at the door, asking whether he was coming to eat.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉已经到门边，问他去不去吃饭。

pairs.target: tā jiāng mùchuí fàng huí kuāng lǐ , zhuīguòqù , lùshang rěnbúzhù hēng le yíxià gāngcái de yīn .
pairs.english: He returned the mallet to the basket and hurried after her, unable to resist humming the note as he went.
pairs.hanzi: 他将木槌放回筐里，追过去，路上忍不住哼了一下刚才的音。

pairs.target: hēng chūlái tài dī , tā huítóu kàn tā .
pairs.english: It came out too low; she turned to look at him.
pairs.hanzi: 哼出来太低，她回头看他。

pairs.target: " bié wèn wǒ . " tā shuō , " wǒ yě hái méi tīng qīng . "
pairs.english: “Don't ask me,” he said. “I haven't heard it clearly yet either.”
pairs.hanzi: “别问我。”他说，“我也还没听清。”
